summary: We are seeking a highly skilled software engineer to develop our cutting-edge C++ application. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in C++ and experience with STL, multithreading, and system-level programming.

Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting
Knowledge of Boost libraries or other modern C++ libraries
Exposure to CMake, Bazel, or other build systems
Experience in unit testing frameworks (GoogleTest etc.)
nice_to_have_skills: Familiarity with ROS / middleware frameworks (Good to have)
